name: Rocket Fellas Inc.
review:
Miners blasting for gold on 30 lines, with wilds, sticky wilds, transforming symbols, a hot reel feature and free spins.

Sticky wilds, transforming symbols and the hot reel can all hit on the same spin, giving the base game more variety than most 30-liners. The explosive mining humour is classic Thunderkick. High volatility, 7,325x cap, 96.1% RTP. Worth a spin in demo.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
